# Volume III: Mission-Critical Electrical Infrastructure and Power Systems Measurement

This volume covers quantity surveying and commercial risk management across the electrical distribution chain: HV/MV substations, ISO 8528 Data Center Continuous standby generators, static and rotary UPS systems, VRLA and Li-ion battery energy storage, overhead track busways, and Mesh Common Bonding Networks (MCBN).
